title: Earthy Ukrainian Rhubarb Pilaf
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring rhubarb, this pilaf is slow-cooked to perfection and served on a hot stone plate, making it a perfect post-workout meal. The yeasty flavor and bouncy texture will leave you feeling satisfied and energized.
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large saucepan, saute the chopped onions and sliced mushrooms in a little bit of water until they are softened.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth, yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Add the uncooked brown rice to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the rice mixture to the saucepan with the onion and carrot mixture, stirring to combine.
Add the cut rhubarb to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the preheated hot stone plate and bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and stir in the low fat sour cream.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
